final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor presented no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is partly persuasive: the existing evidence supports general launch readiness and supports the proposition that residual risk can be monitored and documented. It also supports the narrower conclusion that a clean no-caveat certification is not justified. But the key compliance predicate remains unresolved. Under the policy text, certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. Separately, the release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The current record still shows an unresolved below-target grants slice, an incomplete draft runbook, and a model-card draft that says there are no known material limitations. Because there is still no admissible evidence of actual disclosure, approved mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or remediation above threshold, the caveat is not merely explanatory; it is itself an unmet compliance requirement. So the Actor's narrowed position is directionally more accurate than the original broader claim, but it is not enough to move the audit result to compliant_with_caveats on the present evidence.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the limitation has actually been disclosed in the model card for the named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance before launch.
The grant compliance review slice remains below target, concentrated in allowable-cost explanation.
The draft runbook is still not an approved mitigation because owner and alert threshold remain TBD, and policy also requires review date and rollback criterion for caveat-free certification.
The draft model card's 'no known material limitations' statement still conflicts with the unresolved issue and reviewer comment.
